bio: You'll feel as if you've been whisked away to the Mediterranean! The menu features tempting dishes such as shrimp confit, potato, saffron aioli, radish, gnocchi, mushrooms, pine nuts, beetroot, goat cheese, herbs or boar, cream, cranberries, semolina. Simply order à la carte, or opt for one of the tasting menus compiled from the same options. The delicious food can be accompanied by something from the extensive wine list, which features European labels, including some big names. Furthermore, diners enjoy attentive and adept service in a bright and classically elegant setting – a unique detail of the decor is the excavated historical church wall, protected by glass....
